118392.name: Chabad Lubavitch Guatemala
118392.note: A June 2010 celebration 'marked 10 years since Chabad-Lubavitch sent a Shluchim couple to the Central American country', Rabbi Shalom Pelman and his wife Yael (COLlive, 2 June 2010), counted back: 2000. lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012: '14 Calle 15-26 Zona 13'; today 9 Calle 14-64, Zona 13.

earlier.where: 14 Calle 15-26, Zona 13, Guatemala City (lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012)

3798141.name: Beit Chabad Lubavitch Antigua Lametayel
3798141.note: No start year found. 'the wonderful Chabad of Antigua run with love by the dynamic couple, Rabbi Chaim Silber and his wife Daria' (ReVista, Harvard, 12 Oct 2023). Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in Sept 2017.

people.name: Daria Silber
people.note: 'Dalia Daria Silber' on its chabad.org listing

5544455.name: Chabad Nicaragua
5544455.note: 'Until six and a half years ago, the place lacked a Chabad presence'; the shliach in San Juan del Sur, Rabbi Dovid Attar, had to close the Chabad House and leave in the 2018 unrest (Beis Moshiach via ChabadInfo, 17 July 2018), counted back: early 2012. The Atars ran it in April 2015 (Tico Times, 9 Apr 2015, https://ticotimes.net/?p=61583, a corner building near the beach, the sanctuary on the ground floor), with Nicaragua's first mikvah in 2016. Its chabad.org listing was remade in mid-2022.

people.name: Rabbi Dovid Attar
people.note: Rabbi David Atar on its chabad.org listing

117814.name: Jabad Lubavitch de Costa Rica
117814.note: 'a Chabad Lubavich emissary, Rabbi Hersh Spalter, came to this tropical Central American country from the United States in 1987' (JTA, 21 Apr 2005); 'Chabad's Rabbi Hersh Spalter, who moved to Costa Rica in 1987' (Hadassah Magazine, Dec 2006, https://www.hadassahmagazine.org/?p=7446). Against: 'Rabbi Spalter, in Costa Rica since 1989' (lubavitch.com, 8 Feb 2010), so medium. In Dec 2006 it was in San José 'on Del Banco Cuscatlan Carretera a Pavas'; today in Escazú (opposite the Walmart parking at Escazú Village). He is the head shliach of Costa Rica (and of Central America in 2010).

earlier.where: San José, by the Banco Cuscatlán on the Carretera a Pavas (Hadassah Magazine, Dec 2006)

118946.name: Camp Gan Israel
118946.note: No start year found. Chabad of Costa Rica's day camp (Rabbi Hershel Spalter; Bello Horizonte, San José). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Chabad of Costa Rica began in 1987 (listing 117814).

5472225.name: Chabad S. Teresa
5472225.note: Rabbi Berel and Chana Dubinsky 'visited last Sukkot, and on Pesach, they were back to help the community host a massive Seder', and in July 2022 were moving to Santa Teresa (lubavitch.com, 10 July 2022; COLlive, 'New Shluchim to the Jungles of S. Teresa', 10 July 2022). Before them Rabbi Hershel Spalter of San José came for many years. Year: their first activity (Sukkot 2021); the move was in summer 2022.

5574078.name: Chabad Jaco
5574078.note: Anash.org, 'Second Shluchim Couple to Costa Rica in One Month': Rabbi Shiyaleh and Adina Lipkin would open Jacó's first Chabad House before Rosh Hashanah, a few weeks after the Santa Teresa couple (named July 2022); Rabbi Spalter had sent bochurim there for nearly 20 years (read in search results only: the page sits behind a bot check). Its chabad.org listing was made in July-Aug 2022. Ynet (about Nov 2024): Adina 'has managed the center for the past two years'. Medium: the anash article's date is inferred.

people.name: Rabbi Shiyaleh Lipkin
people.note: Rabbi Yehoshuha (Shia) Lipkin on its chabad.org listing

5701061.name: Chabad of Tamarindo
5701061.note: 'The Rubinsteins and their two children have just moved to Tamarindo to establish the first Chabad Center in the coastal city', appointed by Rabbi Hershel and Chanie Spalter (COLlive, 11 June 2023). They ran it two years, then reopened it before the High Holidays of 2026 'for the second time' (lubavitch.com via CrownHeights.info, 3 Nov 2026).

7321777.name: La Fortuna Chabad House
7321777.note: 'Rabbi Shlomo and Chana Ben-Ami, together with their family, have embarked on their Shlichus to La Fortuna, Costa Rica, where they are opening a new Chabad House' (ChabadInfo, 28 June 2026; COLlive broke it on 16 June 2026).

5930568.name: CTeen Panama
5930568.note: No start year found. At Chanukah 2020 'All the food at the event was organized by CTeen volunteers ... led by Cteen leaders Alan Burakoff and Ariel Felsenstein' (COLlive, 22 Dec 2020), with Rabbi Shlomo Poliwoda. Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in spring 2023.

5961265.name: Tora Or
5961265.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches). A cheder at the Beth El synagogue (Rabbi Yechezkel Ravel). Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about mid-2023.

2871262.name: Chabad Panama
2871262.note: No start year found. 'the Shliach for the Israeli community in Panama City, Rabbi Mendy Karniel' (COLlive, 2 Apr 2021). Today an Israeli center in Paitilla (Calle Gil Colunge 9B) with a kosher restaurant and mikvah. Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in Feb-Mar 2015.

3370507.name: Chabad Boquete
3370507.note: The Poliwodas 'often made the 300 mile commute between the two cities to conduct holiday programs and classes in Boquete before finally settling down for good in August of 2016'; 'In early May, after only one year of operation, Chabad of Boquete inaugurated a new center', a long-term lease in the Hotel Fundadores on the main road (lubavitch.com, 19 June 2017; COLlive, 4 June 2017). Announced: 'New Shluchim to Panama' (COLlive, 18 July 2016: moving at the end of August). Today Calle C con Calle 4, in front of the Hotel Isla Verde.

earlier.where: the Hotel Fundadores on Boquete's main road (a long-term lease; its center from May 2017)

4085561.name: Kosher Bakery - Morton's Bake house
4085561.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches). A kosher bakery in Plaza San Francisco, Alto Boquete, listed under Chabad of Boquete (2016). Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about July-Aug 2018.

4923516.name: Ohaley Chinuch
4923516.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches). A cheder (Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Shaingarten). Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about Oct-Dec 2020.

4946171.name: Mitzva Tank Panama
4946171.note: 'This Chanukah, Panama City was lit up by a beautiful event organized by the new organization “Mitzva Tank Panama,” led by shliach Rabbi Shlomo Poliwoda and Esther Kamhaji (Poliwoda)' (COLlive, 22 Dec 2020). Its chabad.org listing was made in Oct-Dec 2020.

5175431.name: Chabad Playa Venao Panama
5175431.note: The earliest report found: before Pesach 2021, 'the Shliach for the Israeli community in Panama City, Rabbi Mendy Karniel sent 2 bochurim to the beachfront town of Playa Venao to distribute Seder foods' (COLlive, 2 Apr 2021; photos, ChabadInfo, 5 Apr 2021). Its chabad.org listing was made in late June 2021. When Rabbi Yariv and Lital Klein came is not found.

people.name: Rabbi Yariv Klein
people.note: on its chabad.org listing, with Lital Klein; start not found

5274820.name: Chabad of Bocas del Toro
5274820.note: The earliest report found: 'Sukkos Mivtzoim in Bocas del Toro, Panama' (COLlive, 16 Oct 2020, photos only). Its chabad.org listing was made in Sept-Oct 2021. When Rabbi Mordechai Menachem and Sara Chaya Cohen came is not found.

people.name: Rabbi Mordechai Menachem Cohen
people.note: on its chabad.org listing, with Sara Chaya Cohen; start not found

5604369.name: Kolel Torah Panama
5604369.note: No start year found. 'Kolel Torah Panama published its first edition of Seder Pesach Illuminated' (COLlive, 31 Mar 2026), under Rabbi Menachem Mendel Shuchat, overseen by Head Shliach Rabbi Ari Laine; it hosted a Siyum HaShas in June 2026. Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in July-Aug 2022.

extra-panama-beth-el.name: Beth El Synagogue
extra-panama-beth-el.note: Rabbi Aron (Ari) Laine, head shliach and Chief Ashkenazi Rabbi of Panama: 'In 1994, I made my way to Panama, where the Ashkenazi community was on the lookout for a rabbi' (interview, March 2025; 'upon my arrival 30 years ago'). Beth El is the Ashkenazi community's synagogue (its community dates from 1944); the year here is when Chabad's rabbi began there. Its Paitilla campus is from 2014; before that he was at its building in Obarrio.

earlier.where: the Beth El synagogue's building in Obarrio, Panama City, before its Paitilla campus (2014)

117812.name: Casa Lubavitch-Baranquilla
117812.note: 'thirteen years after their arrival in 1990, Rabbi Yossi and Chanie Liberow are still there'; families in Barranquilla had asked Rabbi Yehoshua Rosenfeld of Bogotá to recruit a rabbi; in March 2003 Chabad of Barranquilla completed a four-story building, 'Replacing a variety of rented facilities used over the years' (lubavitch.com, 4 Feb 2003). 'flourished over the last 35 years' (COLlive, Oct 2023, when Rabbi Shaya and Kraindy Liberow joined). Address CRA. 57 #79-44 in 2012 and today.

earlier.where: a variety of rented facilities, before its four-story building (March 2003)

117813.name: Casa Lubavitch-Bogota
117813.note: Rabbi Yehoshua Rosenfeld in Bogotá 'was directing Chabad activities there since 1981' (lubavitch.com, 4 Feb 2003). Its building, Colombia's first Chabad house, was established by the Rohr family (COLlive, Jan 2012). Address Calle 94 #9-52 in 2012 and today.

2562626.name: Lubavitch of Cali
2562626.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches). Rabbi Yehudah and Chaya Slonim on its chabad.org listing. Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about April 2014.

3764606.name: Casa Lubavitch Cartagena
3764606.note: No start year found. In March 2015 there was no Chabad house yet: rabbinical students came for Pesach for the fifth year running and 'Since no kosher catering facilities exist in Cartagena, all of the food is prepared in Barranquilla' (Chabad.org, 31 Mar 2015). By Dec 2024 'the longer established Chabad house' (San Diego Jewish World, 25 Dec 2024). Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in Aug 2017. Today Carrera 1 #8-210, Bocagrande (Rabbi Saadia and Esti Globerman).

people.name: Rabbi Saadia Globerman
people.note: on its chabad.org listing, with Esti Globerman; start not found

5578732.name: Chabad Lubavitch San Andres
5578732.note: 'San Andrés, Colombia, has recently welcomed a new Chabad house, established by the family of Rabbi Mordechai and Dassi Bigio', already active 'during Sukkos' (ChabadInfo, 9 Jan 2023). Rabbi Bigio, from Barranquilla, later renovated the building it uses (lubavitch.com, May 2026). A Jewish Post piece says a Chabad chapter opened on the island in 2013 (not checked).

people.name: Dassi Bigio
people.note: Hadas Bigio on its chabad.org listing

5590453.name: Beth Chabad Salento
5590453.note: No start year found. A Colombian consul met 'the Rebbe's Shliach to Salento' (ChabadInfo, 10 Feb 2026); the Chabad house was damaged in the Aug 2026 earthquake (COLlive; JNS names Rabbi Shmuel Friedman). Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in July-Aug 2022.

5603886.name: Chabad Lubavitch Medellin
5603886.note: No start year found. A new mikvah in Medellín 'joined the many activities offered by Rabbi Levi and Mimi Wanono' (COLlive, 9 Aug 2021). Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in July-Aug 2022.

117879.name: Hogar Jabad Lubavitch
117879.note: 'Merkos L'inyonei Chinuch, the educational arm of the Lubavitch movement, has announced the opening of its new regional office in Caracas, Venezuela', the third in South America after Buenos Aires and Sao Paulo, headed by Rabbi Moshe Perman, 26, born in Israel, assisted by his wife Chaya, formerly of Toronto (JTA, 22 May 1975). lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012: Avenue J Washington, Qta Lore No. 8, San Bernardino (as today).

118344.name: Hogar Jabad Lubavitch
118344.note: No start year found. Chabad of Venezuela's Altamira center (9na. Transversal Altamira, end of Av. Luis Roche; Rabbi Yehoshua Dovid Rosenblum in lubavitch.com's directory, June 2012). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then. Chabad of Venezuela began in 1975 (listing 117879).

119085.name: Or Jabad Day School
119085.note: No start year found. Chabad of Venezuela's preschool (Mrs. Goldie Slavin). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

people.name: Goldie Slavin
people.note: on its chabad.org listing; start not found

4211957.name: Jabad Lubavitch Guayaquil
4211957.note: 'Through the hard work of Shliach Rabbi Uri Tawil ... a new Mikva is being built in Guayaquil' (CrownHeights.info, 23 Dec 2012); Tawil 'has called Guayaquil home for four years' (Chabad.org, April 2016 earthquake, https://www.chabad.org/3305624), counted back: 2012. The Jewish community of Guayaquil built a new synagogue and community center with mikvahs in 2012 and appointed Rabbi Mendy Fried in 2017 (lubavitch.com, 3 Sept 2020); he became Chief Rabbi of Ecuador in 2022. Its chabad.org listing is from Nov-Dec 2018.

7197057.name: Chabad of Montonita
7197057.note: 'The first time Rabbi Yossi Hus stepped foot in Montañita was in 2019. This year, they moved to Montañita to establish the area's first-ever full-time Jewish presence'; the Seder came 'just a month after Chabad opened' (lubavitch.com, 30 Apr 2026; Pesach began 1 Apr 2026). It operates out of a hostel.

117867.name: Chabad Lubavitch de Peru
117867.note: 'Following his marriage to Shterna Sara Slonim, the couple moved in 1987 to Lima, the nation's capital, where they established a Chabad House' (Chabad.org obituary of Rabbi Schneur Zalman Blumenfeld, 1 Nov 2021). Today Av. Salaverry 3075, San Isidro.

544944.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Cusco
544944.note: 'new Chabad centers have opened in Cusco, Peru; Buenos Aires and Bariloche, Argentina' (lubavitch.com, 5 Nov 2006); before that Merkos sent rabbinical students for the holidays. 'Chabad of Cusco ... has served Jewish travelers and locals in the region for the past 20 years' (COLlive, Feb 2026). Rabbi Ofer and Yael Kripor its shluchim by Dec 2008 (CrownHeights.info). lubavitch.com's directory, Jan 2010: 'calle granada 291, cusco'; today Calle Vitoque 631.

extra-peru-pisac.name: Chabad Pisac
extra-peru-pisac.note: 'Opened in April, the Pisac outpost is Chabad's third in Peru, after Lima and Cusco', led by Rabbi Ariel Kadosh, 25, a former student at Chabad Cusco (JTA, 31 May 2023). Rabbi Menachem Mendel and Chaya Mushka Tzikvashvili 'arrived just over a year ago' under the Kripors of Cusco (CrownHeights.info, 17 Apr 2026; COLlive, Feb 2026).

117811.name: Jabad Lubavitch de Chile
117811.note: Rabbi Menashe and Chaya Perman: 'In Chile since 1981, the Permans have experienced the country's last great earthquake of 1985' (lubavitch.com, 5 Mar 2010). lubavitch.com's directory, Jan 2010: 1575 Los Cactus, La Dehesa (as today).

868615.name: Chabad Pucon
868615.note: No start year found. Chaya Perman 'mentions a Chabad House in Pucon, about 500 miles south, that is popular with Israeli backpackers' (CrownHeights.info, 11 May 2011). A Dec 2008 Hebrew Chabad report (cited by Powerbase, not checked) said one was planned for Chanukah 2008, in memory of the Holtzbergs, under Rabbi Elimelech and Goldi Perman. Lead: its chabad.org listing was made in spring 2009. Today General Urrutia 636.

people.name: Rabbi Elimelech Perman
people.note: on its chabad.org listing, with Goldi Perman

117878.name: Beit Jabad Uruguay
117878.note: 'Shemtov, who has been in Montevideo since 1985, came at the behest of the local community' as a rabbinical student; 'When the 23-year-old married later that year, the Rebbe sent him back with his new wife as his permanent representatives to Uruguay' (lubavitch.com, 1 May 2016). Rochi Shemtov had called Montevideo home for 21 years in 2006 (CrownHeights.info). Today Guayaquí 3193.

extra-uruguay-punta-del-este.name: Jabad Punta del Este
extra-uruguay-punta-del-este.note: No start year found. 'Chabad-Lubavitch Rabbi Eliezer Shemtov welcomes thousands of Jews to the resort town of Punta del Este every summer' (December to March), with Shabbat meals for 150 and a youth center planned (Chabad.org, 6 July 2011).

117866.name: Chabad of Paraguay
117866.note: 'Venezuelan-born Rabbi Yehoshua Forma, Chabad representative to the country since 1988'; its first project was the Gan Israel day camp; about 2001 Chabad bought a 1,200 sq meter plot for a permanent facility (lubavitch.com, 30 July 2003). Today Rabbi Levi Feigelstock (and Rabbi Mendel Pink) on its listing, Juan M. Frutos Pane 378.

people.name: Rabbi Levi Feigelstock
people.note: on its chabad.org listing today; start not found
